text:
maya: FYI - Lumina wants to amend their contract: shorten to a 9-month term, add 10 Accelerator seats, and shift payment to Net30. They asked if we can accept a PO instead of upfront CC. Need procurement + legal alignment before sending. cc @kevin-renewals @eli-legal @james-procure :wave:

kevin-renewals: got it. main risks: PO could delay provisioning. propose we include a clear fallback: if PO not received within 7 business days, customer authorizes card charge to prevent onboarding delay. i can draft amendment and Docusign envelope.

maya: signers are Linda M. (CFO) and Sam P. (Head of Procurement). customer hopes to close this week but acknowledges PO latency.

james-procure: we can accept PO but need vendor code + tax/legal entity. do we have an existing vendor code for Lumina? if not, procurement will create one but that adds delay. i can expedite to 48-72h with finance ops that we have the vendor info.

sara-ops: ops note: provisioning is immediate on successful payment. if we go PO + wire, ops needs invoice entity, remit-to, and vendor code to create the billing record. also they previously indicated KMS integration required for keys. confirm KMS scope in amendment.

maya: here's the pricing and prorate that pricing approved earlier (simplified):
```
9-month base subscription: $12,000 annual -> prorated = $9,000
Accelerator add-on: 10 seats x $250/mo = $2,500/mo -> 9 months = $22,500
Onboarding credit: -$1,500
Prorate overlap credit: -$1,000
Net due at amendment execution (pre-credit): $30,000 -> after credits: $27,500 (invoice net30)
```

eli-legal: legal flag: moving from 12mo to 9mo is a material amendment vs MSA. need amendment that: 1) states term change; 2) includes prorate math & invoice terms; 3) specifies payment fallback to card if PO not received within X days; 4) confirms KMS obligations and data residency if applicable. Legal review ~24 hours if we use our renewal template. wet-sign only if Docusign fails.

kevin-renewals: i'll prepare the amendment with a PO field and explicit fallback clause: "If customer does not supply a valid PO within 7 business days of amendment, Redwood is authorized to charge the card on file to avoid provisioning delays." i'll queue the envelope and hold on sending until procurement confirms vendor code or CSM opts for CC fallback.

james-procure: vendor code check: Lumina is VC-4491 in our vendor registry (confirming with finance). if that's accurate we can push PO issuance within 48h. request: customer to email PO to procurement@redwood.com with vendor code & remit entity.

docusign-bot: Envelope created (env_0xBEEF987). Recipients: Linda M. (CFO) - sent; Sam P. (Procurement) - pending. Status: Sent to first signer. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0xBEEF987 :email:

maya: perfect. i'll update the CSM playbook and set a follow-up reminder in 48h. i'll also ask Lumina to confirm vendor code in writing to speed procurement.

sara-ops: ops checklist added to thread: 1) confirm vendor code & remit entity 2) legal approves amendment 3) PO received or CC fallback confirmed 4) send Docusign envelope 5) invoice & provision after signature/payment. ping me when envelope complete and payment method confirmed.

eli-legal: noted. once kevin posts the amendment i'll run review. include a short clause on wet-sign acceptance: scanned countersigned copy acceptable only with ops confirmation and CFO email approval.

kevin-renewals: amendment draft posted to the shared drive and i'll ping when ready to send. leaving note in envelope: "expedite requested: PO/CC fallback to avoid provisioning delay."

maya: thanks team. outcome plan: if PO received within 7 business days -> finalize via PO+signed amend -> invoice net30 -> provision. If PO delayed -> customer authorizes CC charge -> we provision immediately. will update thread when we have PO or CC confirmation. :thumbsup:
